L.M. College of Pharmacy vs Rai University is a government pharmacy college compared with a private university. LM College has a 2025 NIRF Pharmacy rank of 45 on this page, but we do not hold a B.Pharm fee or placement row for it.

sections.heading: L.M. College of Pharmacy vs Rai University for B.Pharm: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose L.M. College of Pharmacy if you want a long-established government pharmacy college with a 2025 NIRF Pharmacy rank of 45. Confirm its official fee and placement notices, because those figures are not on this page.
Choose Rai University if you want recorded B.Pharm fee and 2023 placement figures here. Rai has no NIRF Pharmacy rank on this page.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: We do not hold a quotable B.Pharm fee for L.M. College of Pharmacy on this page. Ask the college for its current official fee circular, including any ACPC or government-quota figure, before you budget.

Rai University has recorded tuition of ₹64,500 a year, plus an application fee of ₹600. The application fee is below the professional fee floor and is not the programme tuition. Confirm Rai's official B.Pharm notice.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Rai University's recorded 2023 figures are an average package of ₹4 lakh and a highest package of ₹6 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.
L.M. College of Pharmacy has no placement row on this page. Ask the college for its latest official placement report, and do not assume a figure that we do not hold.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Rai University lists GUJCET on this page. Gujarat B.Pharm seats are commonly filled through ACPC counselling, which uses GUJCET.
L.M. College of Pharmacy has no exam listed in our records here. Confirm the current ACPC pharmacy brochure for both institutes before you apply.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, on different campuses. L.M. College of Pharmacy is a specialist government pharmacy college. Rai University is a private university campus.
Visit both if commute and lab facilities will decide the choice. The city is the same; the college type is not.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If NIRF 2025 Pharmacy rank and a government college matter most, L.M. College of Pharmacy is the stronger official name, at rank 45, but you must get its fee and placement notices from the college itself.
If you want recorded fee and 2023 placement figures on this page, Rai University is the side we can quote, at tuition of ₹64,500 a year.
Do not use Rai's ₹600 application fee as the programme cost.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, L.M. College of Pharmacy or Rai University, for B.Pharm?
faqs.answer: L.M. College of Pharmacy has a 2025 NIRF Pharmacy rank of 45, but this page has no fee or placement row for it. Rai University has recorded tuition of ₹64,500 a year and 2023 figures of a ₹4 lakh average and a ₹6 lakh highest package, but no NIRF Pharmacy rank here.

faqs.question: What are the recorded B.Pharm fees for L.M. College of Pharmacy vs Rai University?
faqs.answer: We do not hold a B.Pharm fee for L.M. College of Pharmacy on this page. Rai University's recorded tuition is ₹64,500 a year. A ₹600 application fee in the raw rows is not the programme tuition.

faqs.question: Does Rai University accept GUJCET for B.Pharm?
faqs.answer: Yes. Rai lists GUJCET on this page. Gujarat B.Pharm admissions commonly go through ACPC. Confirm the current brochure for both colleges.

faqs.question: How do placements compare?
faqs.answer: Rai University has recorded 2023 figures of a ₹4 lakh average and a ₹6 lakh highest package. L.M. College of Pharmacy has no placement record on this page. Ask the college for its official report.

faqs.question: Are both colleges in Ahmedabad?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, on different campuses. L.M. College of Pharmacy is a government pharmacy college. Rai University is a private university.
